Effectively, a hematoma is seen on the right eyelid, apparently unimportant. In the fundus of the eye intraretinal hemorrhages are observed not only in the eye that the parents refer but also in the other eye. It is striking that the child seems sleepy and with little tone. Which of the following statements should you consider regarding this clinical picture?

opb. It is the normal evolution of a non-perforating intraocular trauma.
